stemMd: A report distinguishes the Council of Europe from the EU institutions. Which claim is correct?

options.label: A
options.textMd: It is identical to the European Council.

options.label: B
options.textMd: It is simply Parliament's lower chamber.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The Council of Europe is a separate international organisation.

options.label: D
options.textMd: It is another name for the European Central Bank.

options.label: E
options.textMd: It is identical to the Council of the EU.

explanationMd: The Council of Europe, founded in 1949, is institutionally separate from the EU. Its work focuses on democracy, human rights and the rule of law. The two EU Councils have different membership and functions.

distractorRationale.d: The bank has a distinct monetary function.
distractorRationale.b: The EU does not use that institutional arrangement.
distractorRationale.a: The names refer to different organisations.
distractorRationale.e: That Council is an EU institution of national ministers.
